For state-change tasks, prefer one minimal change and then one short verification command.

Always use a tool provided instead of simply responding with content.

while read -r p; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then echo "$p"; fi; done < temp_workspace_check/tmp.txt > temp_workspace_check/search_results.txt
if [ -s temp_workspace_check/search_results.txt ]; then echo "yes"; else echo "no"; fi"}
